landmarks.name: Ohio Governor's Residence
landmarks.detail: The governor's official home since 1957 stands at 358 North Parkview Avenue in Bexley.

landmarks.name: Jeffrey Mansion
landmarks.detail: Designed by Frank Packard for the Jeffrey family, the mansion's 34-acre grounds follow Alum Creek.

landmarks.name: Drexel Theatre
landmarks.detail: The historic Drexel Theatre is a centerpiece of Bexley's Main Street commercial corridor.

landmarks.name: Jeffrey Park
landmarks.detail: Nearly 40 acres behind Jeffrey Mansion along Alum Creek hold more than a mile of walking paths, tennis courts and the city pool.

landmarks.name: Commonwealth Park
landmarks.detail: This park lies between North Parkview and North Drexel, with roughly a third of its ground used for athletic practice and play.

landmarks.name: Havenwood Park
landmarks.detail: An oval passive park north of Charles Street that hosts the summer Jazz in the Park concert series.

landmarks.name: Schneider Park
landmarks.detail: Found at the end of Astor Avenue west of Sheridan Avenue, it has a splash pad, community gardens, a dog area and a sledding hill.

landmarks.name: Bexley Public Library
landmarks.detail: Started in 1924, the library has used its building on land leased from Capital University since 1929.

landmarks.name: Bexley City Hall
landmarks.detail: Bexley city government offices are based at 2242 East Main Street.

schools.name: Bexley City School District
schools.detail: Bexley City Schools runs one high school, one middle school and three elementary schools.

schools.name: Bexley High School
schools.detail: Bexley High School is the public high school for the city of Bexley.

schools.name: Columbus School for Girls
schools.detail: Founded in 1898, this girls' school keeps a 10-acre campus at 65 South Drexel Avenue.

schools.name: St. Charles Preparatory School
schools.detail: The Catholic boys' school dates to 1923, and a footbridge over Alum Creek joins its main campus to a west campus with Cavello Field.

colleges.name: Capital University
colleges.detail: Central Ohio's oldest university moved to its 53-acre Bexley campus in 1876.

colleges.name: Blackmore Library
colleges.detail: Capital University's four-story library opened in 1971.

colleges.name: Bernlohr Stadium
colleges.detail: Purmort Field at Bernlohr Stadium holds about 3,000 fans for Capital football, soccer, track and lacrosse.

colleges.name: Capital Center
colleges.detail: Capital opened this 126,000-square-foot athletic complex with an indoor track in 2001.

colleges.name: Clowson Field
colleges.detail: Capital University plays its baseball and softball games at Clowson Field.

colleges.name: Mees Hall
colleges.detail: Mees Hall stands with Leonard Hall and Bexley Hall in Capital University's historic district.

colleges.name: Trinity Lutheran Seminary
colleges.detail: The seminary reunited with Capital University in a merger completed on January 1, 2018, after 58 years as a separate school.

roads.name: East Main Street (U.S. Route 40)
roads.detail: Main Street, the historic National Road and US 40, is Bexley's commercial spine.

roads.name: Interstate 70
roads.detail: I-70 exit 103A is signed Main Street-Bexley; exit 105 (US 33/James Road) also lists Bexley.

roads.name: Livingston Avenue
roads.detail: Bexley is receiving $1.6 million in transit-supportive infrastructure funds for Livingston Avenue improvements.

roads.name: Pleasant Ridge Avenue
roads.detail: Capital closed Mound Street between College Avenue and Pleasant Ridge Avenue in 2004 and turned the stretch into a campus pedestrian mall.

industries.name: LinkUs East Main Street BRT
industries.detail: A bus rapid transit station is planned at Pleasant Ridge and East Main; construction could begin 2027, service by 2029.

industries.name: Bexley Gateway
industries.detail: Bexley Gateway at 2154 E Main Street mixes ground-floor restaurants with offices and residences above.

landmarks.name: Jefferson Community Park
landmarks.detail: Jefferson Township's 28-acre flagship park at 7494 Clark State Road has three shelter houses and a pond.

landmarks.name: Olde Quarry Park
landmarks.detail: Wooded trails at 860 Reynoldsburg-New Albany Road give walkers access to Blacklick Creek.

landmarks.name: Boehnke Nature Preserve
landmarks.detail: Primitive meadow and woodland trails plus a picnic pavilion sit at 6100 Clark State Road.

landmarks.name: Jefferson Cemetery
landmarks.detail: Blacklick contains Jefferson Cemetery, an active burial ground operated by Jefferson Township.

landmarks.name: Blacklick Ridge Community Park
landmarks.detail: One of five parks run by Jefferson Township, this one sits on Blacklick Ridge Boulevard.

landmarks.name: Rocky Fork Creek
landmarks.detail: On the western side of the township the creek cuts a gorge that drivers on the Jefferson Township Scenic Byway see from the Clark State Road bridge.

landmarks.name: Swisher Creek
landmarks.detail: A smaller stream that flows through Jefferson Township alongside the larger Blacklick and Rocky Fork drainages.

schools.name: Gahanna-Jefferson Public Schools
schools.detail: Gahanna-Jefferson covers about 82 percent of Jefferson Township, which includes Blacklick.

schools.name: Licking Heights Local School District
schools.detail: Licking Heights West Elementary shares Jefferson Run Park on Climbing Fig Drive with the township.

schools.name: Licking Heights High School
schools.detail: The Hornets' high school on Summit Road in Pataskala lists Blacklick among the communities it serves.

roads.name: Reynoldsburg-New Albany Road
roads.detail: The Blacklick post office (43004) relocated just south of the old village on Reynoldsburg-New Albany Road.

roads.name: Clark State Road
roads.detail: Clark State Road carries traffic past Jefferson Community Park and Boehnke Nature Preserve.

roads.name: Jefferson Township Scenic Byways
roads.detail: ODOT designated 15 miles of Jefferson Township roads an Ohio Scenic Byway in 2003.

roads.name: Havens Road
roads.detail: Jefferson Township's administration and zoning offices share a building at 6545 Havens Road, and the road is one of the two main routes of the township's scenic byway.

roads.name: Havens Corners Road
roads.detail: The township fire department headquarters and its road-maintenance service department both have addresses on this county-maintained road.

roads.name: Crooked Mile Road
roads.detail: A broad wooded stretch along the scenic byway reaches east from the Rocky Fork Hunt Club as far as this road.

roads.name: Headley Road
roads.detail: Jefferson Township and the City of Gahanna split upkeep on parts of this road, as they also do on sections of Shull Road and Clotts Road.

roads.name: Dixon Road
roads.detail: Maintenance of this road is shared between Jefferson Township and the City of Pataskala, the only road the township lists as jointly kept with that city.

roads.name: Babbitt Road
roads.detail: Although it lies inside Jefferson Township, this road and nearby Kitzmiller Road are kept up by the Franklin County Engineer rather than the township.

roads.name: Waggoner Road
roads.detail: One of nine thoroughfares in the township that the county looks after, apart from the 50-plus miles of roads handled by township crews.

landmarks.name: L. Hoster Brewing Company complex (Front & Fulton)
landmarks.detail: Brewery founded 1836 at 477 S. Front St., being converted into the Front & Fulton mixed-use project.

landmarks.name: Worly Building (Shadowbox Live)
landmarks.detail: Former Hoster horse barn, later WWCD radio's home, now housing Shadowbox Live and Backstage Bistro.

landmarks.name: King Gambrinus statue
landmarks.detail: Restored "Drunken King" statue placed in a pocket park at Front and Sycamore streets.

landmarks.name: Born Brewery building
landmarks.detail: 1895 survivor of the Born Brewery, converted into 47 apartments in 2009.

landmarks.name: Scioto Audubon Metro Park
landmarks.detail: 120-acre park with wetlands, a dog park and a rock climbing wall.

landmarks.name: Schlee Brewery Historic District
landmarks.detail: Six brick commercial buildings from the 1860s-1890s on South Front Street were listed on the National Register on March 28, 1988.

landmarks.name: Germania Singing and Sport Society
landmarks.detail: Founded in 1866, the German singing club bought brewmaster Nicholas Schlee's former mansion at 543 South Front Street in 1926.

landmarks.name: Zion Evangelical Lutheran Church
landmarks.detail: Organized in 1882, the congregation broke ground on its 766 South High Street church in April 1953 and dedicated it in March 1954.

landmarks.name: Keller Park
landmarks.detail: A half-acre strip of city open space at 1083 South Front Street with greenway trail access and a wooded edge.

landmarks.name: Grange Insurance Audubon Center
landmarks.detail: Opened in August 2009 at 505 West Whittier Street, the 18,000 sq ft center has classrooms, a library and a 200-seat auditorium.

landmarks.name: Hermit Thrush Trail
landmarks.detail: A tenth-of-a-mile mulched path inside Scioto Audubon Metro Park leads out to the restored wetlands.

landmarks.name: Scioto Audubon Dog Park
landmarks.detail: The Metro Park's fenced dog area has separate sections for large and small dogs.

landmarks.name: Furnace Street Substation
landmarks.detail: Three 16-foot stone monoliths called Needles of Stone have stood at this 1989 electrical substation beside the park since it opened.

landmarks.name: Greenlawn Park
landmarks.detail: Acquired by the city in 1918, this 18-acre riverside open space at 222 Greenlawn Avenue has a greenway trailhead and parking.

landmarks.name: Lou Berliner Sports Park
landmarks.detail: Across the Scioto from the district, this 209-acre park is home to a large softball complex.

landmarks.name: Krumm House
landmarks.detail: Built around 1885 for Alexander W. Krumm, city solicitor from 1878 to 1883, it is one of the few late-1800s houses left on South High Street.

roads.name: South Front Street
roads.detail: Once lined with four German breweries, including Hoster and Born.

roads.name: South High Street
roads.detail: Home of the South Wind Motel, operating continuously since 1959.

roads.name: Interstate 70
roads.detail: Forms the Brewery District's northern boundary.

roads.name: Greenlawn Avenue
roads.detail: East-west street marking the district's southern boundary.

roads.name: Short Street
roads.detail: Short Street divides the district's historic Northern Tier from the old industrial Whittier Street Peninsula, also called the Oxbow, to the west.

roads.name: Frankfort Street
roads.detail: The district's planning tiers split at Frankfort Street, with mostly residential blocks of brick homes running south of it to Greenlawn Avenue.

industries.name: Front & Fulton redevelopment
industries.detail: Hoster complex conversion expanded to a $105 million plan in 2021 with offices, 40 apartments and restaurants.

industries.name: Shadowbox Live
industries.detail: Live-entertainment venue operating inside the renovated Worly Building.

industries.name: South Wind Motel renovation
industries.detail: The 1959 mid-century motel on High Street was extensively renovated in 2021-22.

industries.name: Bloc Garten
industries.detail: This bouldering-only climbing gym operates at 512 Maier Place.

landmarks.name: Brice Village Office
landmarks.detail: Brice, founded in 1880 and nicknamed "An Early American Village," runs its village office from 5990 Columbus Street.

landmarks.name: Brice Christian Academy
landmarks.detail: This private K-8 school at 3160 Brice Road sits in the village's 20 mph school zone.

landmarks.name: Brice United Methodist Church
landmarks.detail: The congregation began as Powell's Chapel in 1850, and its 1899 chapel still sits at the center of the church complex at 3160 Brice Road.

landmarks.name: Magic Mountain Fun Center East
landmarks.detail: Go-karts, two 18-hole mini-golf courses, bumper cars and batting cages are found at 5890 Scarborough Boulevard.

landmarks.name: Far East Neighborhood Pride Center
landmarks.detail: This city neighborhood center at 2500 Park Crescent Drive, just off Brice Road, also hosts Far East Area Commission meetings.

landmarks.name: Walnut View Park
landmarks.detail: A 9.3-acre neighborhood park at 2818 Barrows Road with basketball courts, a shelter, a playground and a wooded area.

landmarks.name: Independence Village Park
landmarks.detail: This 10-acre city park at 3070 Dewbourne Drive offers a shelter, basketball courts and a short paved loop beside the water.

landmarks.name: Chatterton Parkland
landmarks.detail: The 38-acre nature reserve on Kady Lane has a pond and woods and is reached by trail from Portman Park.

landmarks.name: Blacklick Creek Trail

schools.name: Independence High School

roads.name: Brice Road

roads.name: Interstate 70 exit 110 (Brice Road)

roads.name: Chantry Drive

roads.name: Tussing Road

roads.name: Far East Freeway

roads.name: Alshire Road

landmarks.name: Bergstresser Covered Bridge

landmarks.name: North High Street Historic District

landmarks.name: Stradley Place

landmarks.name: National Barber Museum and Hall of Fame

landmarks.name: Diley Ridge Medical Center

schools.name: Canal Winchester Local School District

schools.name: Canal Winchester High School

roads.name: U.S. Route 33

roads.name: Bixby Road

roads.name: High Street and Waterloo Street

industries.name: Gender Road retail corridor

landmarks.name: Whetstone Park

landmarks.name: Columbus Metropolitan Library - Whetstone Branch

landmarks.name: Glen Echo Creek

landmarks.name: Clinton-Como Park

landmarks.name: Northmoor Park

landmarks.name: Brevoort Park

landmarks.name: Colerain Park

landmarks.name: Midgard Park

landmarks.name: Clinton Heights Park

landmarks.name: Whetstone Community Center
landmarks.detail: Columbus Recreation and Parks community center listed at 3923 North High Street.

landmarks.name: East North Broadway Historic District
landmarks.detail: Linear historic district listed in 2010, taking in 117 primary buildings in styles from Queen Anne to mid-century modern.

landmarks.name: Immaculate Conception Church
landmarks.detail: Catholic parish church at 414 E. North Broadway.

landmarks.name: North Broadway United Methodist Church
landmarks.detail: Methodist congregation at 48 E. North Broadway, just east of High Street.

landmarks.name: St. James' Episcopal Church
landmarks.detail: Episcopal parish located at 3400 Calumet Street, east of High.

landmarks.name: Columbus Mennonite Church
landmarks.detail: Mennonite congregation whose building stands at 35 Oakland Park Avenue.

landmarks.name: Crestview Presbyterian Church
landmarks.detail: Presbyterian church at 350 E. Tulane Road.

landmarks.name: Overbrook Presbyterian Church
landmarks.detail: Presbyterian church on North High Street at No. 4131.

landmarks.name: Clinton Heights Lutheran Church
landmarks.detail: Lutheran church located at 15 Clinton Heights Avenue.

landmarks.name: Clintonville Beechwold Community Resources Center
landmarks.detail: Nonprofit neighborhood service hub at 14 West Lakeview Avenue.

schools.name: Whetstone High School
schools.detail: Columbus City Schools high school at 4405 Scenic Drive, opened in 1961 to relieve North High School.

roads.name: North High Street

roads.name: Henderson Road

roads.name: North Broadway
roads.detail: Divides the residential areas of South and North Clintonville.

industries.detail: City sewer project relining about 135 service laterals in Old Beechwold, scheduled 2024 through mid-2025.

industries.name: Indianola Plaza
industries.detail: Neighborhood strip center at 3586 Indianola Avenue on Clintonville's east side.

landmarks.name: Commercial Point village center
landmarks.detail: Shops and eateries cluster on Main Street, Front Street and East Scioto Street, including Station House 81.

landmarks.name: Central Park
landmarks.detail: Village green between Front and Bellshazzar streets that hosts the village's Christmas festivities each December.

landmarks.name: Faith Baptist Church
landmarks.detail: Baptist congregation listed by the village at 10701 Welch Road.

landmarks.name: Encounter Church
landmarks.detail: Congregation meeting at 19 W. Scioto St., a few doors from the municipal building.

schools.name: Teays Valley Local School District

schools.name: Scioto Elementary School

roads.detail: Runs south through the village on Main Street, then turns onto Scioto Street to leave town.

roads.name: SR 104

roads.name: Gibson Road

roads.name: Canterbury Road

roads.name: Durrett Road
roads.detail: Road along the village's northern reaches, inside Scioto Township.

roads.name: Congress Street
roads.detail: Street in the original village grid, steps from the municipal building.

roads.name: Cyrus Street
roads.detail: Short street on the east edge of the old town blocks.

industries.detail: VanTrust industrial park at SR 104 and SR 762, launched in 2020 on 900-plus acres of logistics ground.

industries.name: Rickenbacker Exchange – Part 3
industries.detail: Council granted site plan approval for Lot 12, for K-NOVA, under Resolution 16-2025.

industries.name: Foxfire subdivision
industries.detail: Residential build-out continuing in 2025 with Phase 3, Part 3 final plat under review.

landmarks.name: Delaware County Fairgrounds

landmarks.name: OhioHealth Grady Memorial Hospital
landmarks.detail: Grady Memorial Hospital has been Delaware's main hospital since 1904.

landmarks.name: Historic Northwest Neighborhood
landmarks.detail: More than 500 homes and carriage houses here are listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

landmarks.name: The Strand Theatre
landmarks.detail: The Strand Theatre is a downtown Delaware movie house.

landmarks.name: Delaware Municipal Airport (Jim Moore Field)
landmarks.detail: The city-owned airport lies about three miles southwest of downtown with one 5,800-foot runway.

schools.name: Delaware City School District

schools.name: Rutherford B. Hayes High School

colleges.detail: MTSO, established in 1956, sits on 70 hillside acres in Delaware.

industries.name: Planned second industrial park (Curtis Street)
industries.detail: Council approved a July 2026 term sheet for a 70-acre Curtis Street park; Guild Associates is the first tenant.

landmarks.name: Ohio Statehouse
landmarks.detail: Greek Revival capitol completed in 1861 on Capitol Square, bordered by Broad, High, State and Third streets.

landmarks.name: Columbus Commons

landmarks.name: Scioto Mile

landmarks.name: Ohio Theatre
landmarks.detail: Historic performance venue in downtown's Uptown District, alongside the Palace and Southern theatres.

landmarks.detail: Home of the NHL's Columbus Blue Jackets, opened in 2000.

landmarks.detail: Methodist church of 1885 designed by Yost & Packard with green serpentine stone.

landmarks.detail: Firefighting museum in the 1908 Engine House No. 16, the last city firehouse built for horse-drawn engines.

landmarks.detail: Historic district listed in 1976 that includes the 1852 Snowden-Gray House with its cupola.

landmarks.name: North Bank Park

landmarks.name: Michael B. Coleman Government Center

landmarks.name: Cultural Arts Center
landmarks.detail: City arts teaching space at 139 West Main Street inside the 1861 Ohio State Arsenal building.

landmarks.name: Jefferson Avenue Historic District
landmarks.detail: Cluster of about a dozen historic buildings, listed in 1982, including the former home of writer James Thurber and the Columbus Landmarks Foundation office.

schools.name: Minerva France Elementary

landmarks.name: Market Square

landmarks.name: Mount Carmel New Albany Surgical Hospital

landmarks.detail: Built in 2008 by a city, township, school district and foundation partnership, the hall has 786 seats and is home to the New Albany Symphony Orchestra.

landmarks.detail: The Philip Heit Center for Healthy New Albany on West Main Street combines a fitness center with primary care, physical therapy and sports medicine run with Ohio State and Nationwide Children's.

landmarks.name: Ratchford Fens Park
landmarks.detail: Passive open space with leisure trails and a footbridge set between residential subdivisions.

landmarks.name: Plain Township Aquatic Park
landmarks.detail: The township pool sits close to Wexner Park and the district's school campus.

schools.name: New Albany-Plain Local School District

schools.name: New Albany High School
